paper_title: Search for axion-like dark matter using solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance
notes: CASPEr-electric solid-state NMR search using 207Pb in PMN-PT. Reports |gd|<9.5e-4 GeV^-2, corresponding to oscillating neutron EDM amplitude < 1.0e-21 e*cm, over 162-166 neV mass range (39.1-40.2 MHz). The EDM coupling g_d maps to AxionEDM (neutron EDM d_n in e*cm). Also reports gradient coupling g_aNN < 2.8e-1 GeV^-1 (AxionNeutron). Mass range converted via m=4.136e-15*f; 39.65 MHz center band corresponds to ~1.64e-7 eV. Data taken as approximately flat limit across the band; only the overall bound is quoted in text (no per-bin table). DM density standard halo assumed (~0.4 GeV/cm^3). | Vision: Y-axis plotted is nucleon EDM coupling g_d in GeV^-2 (left axis). The constraint |g_d|<9.5e-4 GeV^-2 corresponds to neutron EDM amplitude d_n < 1.0e-21 e*cm. Plotted values are g_d (GeV^-2), not d_n directly; conversion: d_n ~ 1.05e-18 * g_d (e*cm per GeV^-2 in their calibration). Box-shaped exclusion from 162-166 neV with steep walls; floor ~9e-4 GeV^-2. | Calibration: No calibration needed | Auto-corrected couplings: ×1.00e-12 (12 orders too large)
